gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-martel-sans: Loose, scribbled and personal: Coming Soon looks jotted down in a hurry, its o a simple ring. And Martel Sans, a plain sans with generous curves and a high mean line, does the steady talking where the heading only gestures.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-matangi: Matangi has a chunky, rounded body, its strokes like twine pressed flat and its curves left open. Matangi holds the text together while Coming Soon brings the handwritten, casual flick that feels jotted by hand.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-maven-pro: Coming Soon draws every o as a ring with a constant wall, like quick handwriting on a notepad, with lowercase rising close to the capitals. Maven Pro, a sans with a welcoming gap in its c, is the quiet partner.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-michroma: Michroma gives each sans-serif letter a wide berth on both sides, wide and technical, with a tall-bodied lowercase. But Coming Soon undercuts that precision with casual handwriting whose lines never thicken or thin.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre stands tall, a plain sans drawn like bent wire, with an s that opens generously between its bends. Yet Coming Soon gives the pair its charm, with casual pen-and-paper letters and rings for o's.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big and round, its lowercase eyes huge, like laser-cut sheet in one stroke width. Coming Soon is best at casual, handwritten warmth, while the sans-serif body is best at staying crisp and uniform.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Approachable and clean, Mochiy Pop P One lets a wide stretch of blank space sit between each sizable sans-serif letter. Shrink the heading and the handwriting loses ground.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-montserrat-alterna: Montserrat Alternates reads as crisp and contemporary, its c as open as a bent paperclip and its lowercase crowding the capital line. Page after page stays sturdy and uniform.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-montserrat-underli: Montserrat Underline reads as crisp and businesslike, with round bowls whose walls never swell and a lowercase that outgrows its capitals. And Coming Soon, scrawled like pen on paper, gives the pair its loosest, most personal quality.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-mozilla-headline: Approachable from the first glance, Mozilla Headline fills a plain sans body with big lowercase letters and a splayed c terminal. But Coming Soon steals the charm, bent like wire-formed signage at a constant thickness.
